property.name: Text 1
property.value: This place was designed to look like a dump. At the very least, they know what they're doing.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: The nerve! It took us so long to finally get here to work, and the whole place is a mess. Don't believe me? Look at this! The owner left the map folder, in the same directory as the viruses folder! Now, the viruses outnumber the work team two to one!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Hey, cut the admins some slack! Between storing the area assets and managing them, all that made this possible was fixing their communications.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Heh. No one will miss my handiwork.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Cut trees, cut trees, cut trees... What are we signing with our blood here again?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'm only here to make sure things progress down here. Yes, we made this whole area with blocks. How else did you think? Certainly not with a MinuScule Paintbrush!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: How to patiently, and POLITELY tell Kelee to start putting arrow tiles and teleports so we don't have to walk ALL the way here...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Construction going as planned. Doc's going to be hyped about the new waste disposal zone. We plan to remove the work room, to make room for a power-sanitation area. In case you're blind, this area's full of gross, stagnant water!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: This water represents how we'll treat the rest of this server. Don't like our filthy attitude? Then clean the water!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Is that... more Digimon assets? Sigh. ...Kelee, stop ripping rubbish! ...Huh? Who's Kelee? If you value your life, you didn't hear that name from me. We're all being watched.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Great. Wonder what garbage THIS platform will house once it does...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Betcha I can snipe one of them from here.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: HELLO! THIS SERVER IS OFF-LIMITS. PLEASE LEAVE. ....WHAT? YOU'VE BEEN GIVEN ACCESS? MY BAD. MIND THE MESS!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: The Square is messed up again. We've even relocated most of the viruses away!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Don't mind me. I'm ... I'm debugging.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Why are we not paid for this?

properties.property: I don't think they've filled this guy in... All of the navis are getting deleted after this place is finished! ...but I know where my loyalties are, so I'm spared...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I'M NOT SURE WHAT EVERYONE'S DEAL IS. EVERYONE'S SO WHINEY! WHAT WAS IN THEIR CEREALS THIS MORNING?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Oooh, ONB made this place? I thought they mostly just reused assets. Hats off to them!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Oh, I get it. The green, lined area is the main road... So, how do you get over there?

property.name: Text 1
property.value: You'd be glad there are many breaks in the roads. This place used to be so much bigger! You can call this an improvement, thanks to all those Mettaurs.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: The projector shows some ambitious assets we might be implementing at a later date. We have a list of priorities, so they won't be in there any time soon.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: We could start with putting a BBS. That'd be a good boost towards bringing traffic. I'd say we have enough props... at 200, and still counting up...

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Did... am I imagining things, or......? Yes. It would seem the 'lower level' houses a lot of Heel Navis. I hope this is not foreboding.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Kelee is still in hiding. Apparently, some pranksters are trying to push her down the rails.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Are the moppers still wasting their time? I'm trying hard, but I can't tell them to do their job!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Once this road is done, it'll connect to this large highway. Yeah! It'll apparently be a large street with vehicles, for fast travel! I'm patenting it! "Cyber-Bus"! Beat that!
